name_reason: Convention-compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=portrait, descriptor=sprite_cache). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own/another address). Descriptor accurately reflects the portrait sprite cache. It is a 4-byte pointer; sibling pointers are mixed on the _ptr suffix (data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr uses it, but the adjacent same-role pointer data_fd2_chapter_portrait_load_buffer @0x53A59 does not), so the missing _ptr is consistent with established precedent and not worth a 38-call-site rename. Name reflects role and data semantics clearly.
purpose: Base pointer to the heap-allocated 200KB (malloc(0x32A00)) portrait sprite cache buffer used to hold decoded character/portrait sprite frames during field-map and battle rendering.
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS 4-byte pointer slot. NULL at startup (CRT BSS-zero). Assigned the malloc(0x32A00) result by fd2_load_portrait_to_cache (@0x110B0, first-time alloc + fill from FDICON.B24) and fd2_restore_portrait_cache_from_tmp (@0x29143, realloc + reload from FD2.TMP); free()'d and reset to 0 by fd2_load_chapter_battle_data on each chapter rebuild. The pointed-to buffer = a 0x780-byte frame-offset lookup table (40 portraits x 12 sprites x 4-byte absolute offsets) at the head, followed by packed sprite payload appended per cached portrait. Readers load this pointer, fetch *(int32*)(ptr + frame*4) as the per-frame byte offset, and add it back to ptr to reach the sprite bytes (e.g. fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos, fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel). Companion globals: data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_buffer_used @0x539EC (write cursor), data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_id_list_base @0x53B17 (parallel id list), data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_count @0x53BDF (slot count, 0..40).
datatype: uint32 (4-byte pointer to heap buffer; void*/uint8* at use sites). Ghidra shows the slot as undefined (1-byte sublabel) but every access is a 32-bit pointer load/store.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit pointer holding the base address of the malloc'd portrait sprite cache buffer (heap), or NULL when no cache is allocated.
notes: src/rsrc/rsrc.c comment block (the data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache @0x53A61 section) is already precise, accurate, and consistent with the live Ghidra plate; no src edit needed. Ghidra plate already detailed and consistent with src and with my refined understanding (4-byte pointer slot, 200KB malloc buffer, 40x12x4 lookup table layout, writers/readers, uint32 model); left unchanged. Verified via xrefs (writers fd2_load_portrait_to_cache @0x110B0 + fd2_restore_portrait_cache_from_tmp @0x29143 WRITE; ~36 reader sites), read_memory (zeros = BSS), and decompile of writers + 2 readers (fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos, fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel). 0x780 = 40*12*4 confirms the 40-portrait lookup-table capacity. No logic touched.
